text: Assign news a specific time (for example, 18:00–18:30) and only from 1–2 sources. That’s it! Let’s be honest — the news background is negative right now. And this information load needs to be dosed, otherwise your mind will be in threat mode even when there is no threat nearby. After just a week, background anxiety decreases, sleep improves, and a sense of control over life appears. And it’s all so simple — you yourself create (or destroy) the boundaries of your psychological safety.
